_doc: Nightly housekeeping (jobs/housekeeping.py, decision 103). profiles: the bot's own Chromium profiles, folder names under .browser/ only (anything that resolves outside .browser/ is refused, so the owner's real Chrome can never be named here). cache_dirs: folders inside each profile that hold only Chrome's re-downloadable caches, checked against the real profiles on 2026-11-10; a path containing a protected name (Cookies, Login Data, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Preferences, ...) is refused. Service Worker/ScriptCache is left out on purpose: it pairs with Service Worker/Database and is a few MB. logs: our append-only logs, rotated above log_max_bytes keeping log_keep old copies (miniapp.log rotates itself). inbox_tmp_max_age_h: leftover .tmp files in .browser/miniapp_inbox older than this are removed. min_free_gb: below this on the repo's disk, the home disk or the temp disk, the owner gets one message per run.
